description: Fetch a Google Slides presentation's slide list — object id and page-element count per slide. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Fetch a Google Slides presentation by id and return a summary of its slides: one row per slide carrying the object id needed to target it in a later structural edit, plus how many page elements - text boxes, images, shapes - that slide holds. The read that precedes editing a deck.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with a slides list ({object_id, element_count}) and a count.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize how many slides the deck has. Suggest slides_export for a viewable rendered copy.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Fetch a Google Slides presentation's slide summary.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id. gsuite.not_found: the presentation id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.not_found: verify the presentation id. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
